notes: Shared escalating milestone curve. Weights 1 : 1.6 : 2.5 : 4 at +5 / +10 / +15 / +20. betweenShare of the next spike drips across the in-between levels; spikeShare lands on the milestone itself. package is the total added multiplier at the cap (1 + package). applyTo names the v78 consumers; unique signature effects also use this curve via enchant and consume levels. setPieceWeights follow the same ratio at 2 / 3 / 5 / 6.
